decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album 'Come into My Life'. The source documents confirm two distinct albums with this title by different artists: 1) 'Come into My Life (Gala album)' by Italian singer Gala (D1S1, D2S2, D3S5), released in 1997. 2) 'Come into My Life (Joyce Sims album)' by American singer-songwriter Joyce Sims (D6S1, D7S4), released in 1987. Both are valid answers to the ambiguous query. 'ABBA' (C2) is incorrect; while D5S2 mentions '*Come into My Life* Studio album by ABBA', the surrounding text in D5 and D4 indicates this is likely a hallucinated or corrupted entry in the source data (contradicted by D1S1 which explicitly defines the Gala album, and D6S1 defining the Sims album, while no credible source links ABBA to this specific title in the provided text). 'Justin Bieber' (C3) is explicitly mentioned in D4S2 as a false claim ('...debut studio album... by Canadian pop singer Justin Bieber'), serving as a distractor/error in the source text, not a valid artist. Therefore, the valid artists are Gala and Joyce Sims.
